column1: # Title:    JWST measured thermal background for observation planning: MIRI Imager
# Author:   Kate Rowlands (krowlands@stsci.edu) and Marshall Perrin (mperrin@stsci.edu)
# Date:     2026 May 07
# Version:  6.0
# Format:   comma separated variables (csv)
# Pedigree: This is a model thermal background for JWST derived from an ensemblee of in-flight
# background measurements. See Technical Reports by Rowlands and Cracraft for data and methods:
#    Rowlands et al. 2025   JWST-STScI-008978  "Monitoring the MIRI MRS Backgrounds"
#    https://www.stsci.edu/files/live/sites/www/files/home/jwst/documentation/technical-documents/_documents/JWST-STScI-008978.pdf
#    Cracraft et al. 2025   JWST-STScI-008928  "Monitoring MIRI Imager Backgrounds"
#    https://www.stsci.edu/files/live/sites/www/files/home/jwst/documentation/technical-documents/_documents/JWST-STScI-008928.pdf
# The values here were obtained based on those methods iterated in May 2026 for the ensemble of data available then.
# Measured background levels were obtained for each MIRI imager filter and various MRS wavelengths
# for many datasets.  The estimated non-thermal background components (zodi
# were subtracted based on the JBT models.  This resulted in a set of estimated thermal background
# levels for Imager and MRS.  Splines were used to fit and scale the prior model curve
# thermal_curve_jwst_jrigby_4.0.csv to pass through the measured background levels at > 15 microns.
# This was done separately for the MIRI Imager and MRS measurements to accomodate their distinct
# background levels.
# Columns: wavelength (micron) and equivalent sky radiance (MJy/SR)
